run_generate_geo_query: run the geo query generation script with a specified model and device
run_IncrementalGrammarConstraint: run grammar-constrained text generation using an EBNF grammar file and tokenizer
run_GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor: run a logits processor that constrains model output to match an EBNF grammar
run_StringRecognizer: run a string recognizer to validate generated text against a parsed EBNF grammar
run_parse_ebnf: run an EBNF grammar parser to extract grammar encoding and symbol table
